targetCompanyImage.name: Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform
targetCompanyImage.description: The Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform is a U.S. portfolio of carrier-neutral data centers and interconnection facilities held through asset-level joint ventures and operated by FifteenFortySeven Critical Systems Realty. The partnership began with its September 3, 2020 acquisition of the Wells carrier hotel in Milwaukee and later expanded through properties including Pittock Block, AlohaNAP, DRFortress and facilities in Chicago, Orangeburg, Wyoming, Michigan, South Bend and McAllen. 1547 reports more than 1.25 million square feet under management. Harrison Street and 1547 are current co-owners, but exact platform stakes, the Harrison Street fund and any umbrella legal entity are not publicly disclosed. Corporate 1547 is the operator and sponsor rather than a company proven to be owned by Harrison Street, and the individual facilities are assets within the platform. No platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: Harrison Street and 1547 completed their first joint acquisition, the Wells carrier hotel and data center in Milwaukee.
The partnership acquired four additional facilities from CIM Group, expanding the Harrison Street–1547 venture to six data centers while 1547 remained operator.
Harrison Street and 1547 added AlohaNAP to their joint national connectivity platform, which then exceeded one million square feet.
Harrison Street and 1547 announced full occupancy and a further expansion at the Orangeburg data center, confirming continuing joint platform activity.
